description.value: Delicado's is a funky, high-energy southwestern cafe and deli known for freshly made wraps, burritos, enchiladas, and homemade soups prepared daily on the premises. The Nanaimo North location is one of several BC franchises offering both dine-in and takeout, with a mini-market stocked with specialty hot sauces, salsas, and oil-free hummus. It's a solid stop for cyclists wanting a filling, colourful meal with plenty of vegetarian-friendly options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone (+1 250 390-0700) matches the 'Nanaimo North' location on the website (250-390-0700), confirming this record maps to 404-6581 Aulds Road, Nanaimo, B.C. V9T 6J6. The website prominently advertises 'DINE IN / TAKEOUT' and lists several explicitly meatless menu items (Veggie roll-up, Garden Medley, Falafel), supporting those amenity values. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Delicado's' but website branding is 'Delicado's Deli' — minor name discrepancy.
OSM record has no address; address 404-6581 Aulds Road, Nanaimo, BC V9T 6J6 sourced from website by matching the OSM phone number to the Nanaimo North listing.
This is a franchise chain with at least three BC locations (Nanaimo Downtown, Nanaimo North, Courtenay); verify that a separate OSM record does not also exist for the Nanaimo Downtown location.
